notes.title: Celebrating Hearthstone Darkmoon Faire Update with 100 packages in Teleporter!
notes.notes:
We will celebrate the newest Darkmoon Faire update of HS in the tavern, and open 100 new packages to find the latest legendaries! Come join us tonight in the Drunk Dragon Tavern!

notes.title: Teleporter: World of Gamers (Alpha) Release Event
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37364528/bae68f3f0ddbd83eb0cadd0b7d4548dea106fb5c.png[/img]
We are excited to finally announce that Teleporter: World of Gamers alpha version is now available to download. We are gonna meet today in the tavern at 9 pm CET (10 pm CEST) to celebrate together with the community. Grab your VR headset and join this amazing night!
